content:
maya: quick pass on Security > Keys & Retention UI. had a few UX/accessibility nits from the design review today. dropping notes here.

sam: thanks, fire away.

maya: 1) retention presets panel is ambiguous. label reads "Retention" but presets show "30/90/365" with no units. users thought it was days or minutes. suggest "Retention period (days)" and show "30 days" text.

liam: easy enough. presets component stores numbers as days, we just hide units in compact layout. we can surface units and keep compact spacing.

maya: 2) region dropdown: when billing region is used as default we currently say "Inferred region: US" in small grey text. testers missed this and assumed US was chosen by them. propose a stronger hint: "Defaulted from billing region (changeable)" with a link to explain impact on KMS.

kevin: note that changing region invalidates some key bindings. we should warn inline when user picks a different region: small banner "Changing region may require reconfiguring keys".

liam: true. region-change API triggers a rekey-check. we can add a non-blocking warning and a link to docs.

anya: a11y: KMS state pills (Managed / Customer) are problematic. in light theme the fill is fine but text contrast is 3.8:1. target is 4.5:1 for AA. suggestion: switch to outline variant + stronger text color. Also, the pill isn't keyboard focusable. Keyboard users can't discover the extra info. Add tabindex=0 and aria-describedby that points to the tooltip id.

maya: agree. also we should ensure the pill conveys ownership via accessible name not just visual color. e.g., "aria-label=Key ownership: customer-managed".

liam: implementing tabindex on a non-interactive span can be surprising. better to make it a button with role=presentation and aria attributes, so it can be focused and the tooltip opened via keyboard.

kevin: copy nit: audit log entries use shorthand like "key rotated" and sometimes omit actor. ask to change pattern to "Encryption key rotated by [name]" and include full ISO timestamp with timezone suffix.

a11y-bot: automated check: audit log timestamp lacks timezone in 12 out of 30 sample rows. flagging for consistency.

maya: good call. prefer "2026-04-02 09:12:33 UTC" format. it's machine readable and clear.

sam: design suggestion: add a small "i" icon next to the retention label that opens a short explanation in a dialog (not tooltip) about what is retained (generated content, request logs, embeddings). dialog should be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers.

anya: prefer dialog over tooltip for longer explanations because tooltips aren't reliably exposed to screen readers. use role=dialog and set focus trap. include a skip link back to the control.

liam: backend impact: expanding retention help to list embeddings retention will require us to update the schema for retention metadata per model. low lift but needs coordination with infra.

maya: ok add to engineering ticket.

kevin: release notes draft: "Console: clarified retention units and presets; added clearer region default hint and reconfiguration warning; improved KMS ownership accessibility and added timezone-aware audit timestamps." will iterate.

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/PR/2024  CI: pending.

sam: attaching updated mock: https://figma.redwood/file/efgh  mock includes outline pill, region hint copy, retention units, and info dialog copy.

maya: plan: liam to implement pill as focusable button + aria-label, add dialog for retention help, backend to tag retention units, anya to run a11y pass once PR is ready. aim for next minor release.

anya: i'll run axe + NVDA pass and report results here after PR lands. if any blockers re contrast or focus traps, i'll call it out.

liam: starting work tonight. will post WIP when implemented.

maya: thanks team. small follow-ups: kevin add docs link in banner, sam finalize tooltip/dialog copy, liam include UTC in audit render, anya run tests. :thumbsup:
